fits: The Studio project moxir-v1-1 in the space moxir (the MOXIR hall, scene metres, y up, floor y = 0). Another project needs its own file; scripts/nav/discover-places.cjs prints what to base one on and, with NAV_PLACES, checks a file against the scene it is meant for.

provenance.source: Camera coordinates read from the scene by the free-move speed work (probe-constant-speed.cjs places table; break/kit.cjs poses), 2026-10-13. Numbers only, no scene content.
